identity.name: Clinical Orthopaedics and Related Research (CORR)
identity.publisher: Wolters Kluwer / Lippincott (for the Association of Bone and Joint Surgeons)
identity.source_note: Authoritative CORR Instructions for Authors, fetched cleanly (89,448 normalized chars) from the Editorial Manager / Ovid submission site — this is the page the Editorial Manager 'Instructions for Authors' link points to. The publisher's journals.lww.com/clinorthop 'Information for Authors' page is a Cloudflare-gated pointer stub with no formatting rules, so it was not used as the source.

encoding_notes: guidelines_url points to the live Editorial Manager / Ovid Instructions for Authors (the real, rule-bearing guide). The journals.lww.com/clinorthop 'Information for Authors' page is only a Cloudflare-gated pointer stub and was deliberately not used.

CORR no longer publishes case reports ('CORR no longer publishes case reports' / 'Case closed—discontinuing case reports'), so case_report/case_series are intentionally absent. article_types maps: Clinical Research and Basic Research and Survey submissions -> original_research (they share the structured Background/Questions/Purposes/Patients-Methods/Results/Discussion format); Systematic Review, Meta-analysis, and CORR Synthesis -> systematic_review.

sections and word_limits are encoded only for original_research, whose structure and abstract format the guide specifies in full. systematic_review is accepted but the page does not give a distinct section list or numeric limits for it, so it is listed in article_types only.

No manuscript word limit is stated on the page (word_limits numeric fields null). The abstract is structured (Background / Questions-Purposes / Patients-Methods / Results / Conclusion / Level of Evidence) with a per-section cap of '~250 words or less per section' and no stated total, so abstract max_words is null.

Blinding: 'CORR utilizes a double-blind peer review system; please remove all author-identifying information from the manuscript.' The title page is uploaded as a separate document from the blinded manuscript. scrub_metadata true is an operational inference consistent with author-side double-blind compliance (docx author metadata is identifying); the page states body-identifier removal but not metadata scrubbing explicitly.

Title page elements are guide-stated: title, author names + final degree(s) + affiliation + email for all authors, corresponding author with full mailing address, conflict-of-interest statement (disclosures), ethical review committee statement (ethics_statement), a statement of where the work was performed (no enum slot), and acknowledgments. authors_degrees 'include' (final degrees).

references style is a 'modified AMA' with journal-specific rules: list ordered ALPHABETICALLY by first author's surname but numbered; in-text markers are numbers in square brackets, explicitly 'not in superscript', placed before sentence punctuation (e.g. '...disciplines [3].') -> in_text bracket, in_text_punctuation before; up to 6 authors listed, else first 3 + 'et al.' -> et_al_threshold 6; official PubMed journal abbreviations, italicized -> journal_abbrev nlm. include_doi false: DOIs are not stated as a general requirement (a DOI appears only in a retraction-citation example).

Figures uploaded separately in JPEG/TIFF/PNG; numbered in arabic numerals; legends removed from figures and placed in a section following the References list -> figure_legends_section; multi-part figures cited as e.g. 'Fig. 2a-b' -> callout_style 'Fig.'. min_dpi not stated for static figures (null). Tables provided as separate editable Word .doc/x files with a heading (no legend) -> placement separate_file; heading above/below not explicitly stated (caption_position null); arabic numbering.

Layout font and spacing are guide-stated ('all text must be double-spaced and 12-point Times New Roman font'). line_numbers 'none', page_numbers.show false, and running_head.show false because the guide specifies none of these; page_size, margins, alignment, first_line_indent, and heading styles are not stated (null).

declarations: ICMJE conflict-of-interest disclosure form required at original submission and an ethical review committee statement (with a copy of the ethics-committee letter) is required -> both required. patient_consent required for identifiable patient photographs, and trial_registration required for RCTs (a registration number is needed before review) — included in order but treated as conditional, not in the always-required set.

misc.orcid_required false: 'it is not required that authors register an ORCID before submitting to CORR.' cover_letter_required false: no cover letter is required by the page. issn, highlights, and title_case not stated (null). Only a single corresponding author is permitted (not representable in schema).
